category_title: Adult students with high statistics anxiety and low math self-efficacy
minimal_context: The student is attempting to use statistical software to perform data analysis tasks during a weekly lab session.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please open the statistical software and begin the data analysis procedure for this week's lab.

STUDENT: Just looking at this program terrifies me. Yes, I am highly stressed about having to do this.

TUTOR: What do you think you should click first?

STUDENT: I don't know. I usually need my partner for this because their computer skills are a lot higher than mine.

TUTOR: Keep trying to figure it out on your screen.

STUDENT: I can't, this just terrifies me too much. I'm going to stop and just let my partner do the software part since their computer skills are a lot higher than mine, which is the only thing that lowers my anxiety.

options.A: Establish, through consensus, the working practices of the collaborative team via a pledge and reinforce it.
options.B: Implement relatively tight timelines for completing the data analysis tasks during the weekly lab sessions.
options.C: Provide a curated list of online resources for independent study outside of the weekly lab sessions.
options.D: Maintain a ratio of praise to correction at 3:1 or 4:1 during the weekly lab sessions.
